Name: Stardew Valley Flower Show
Author: 0Logophile0
Description:
[center][b][size=6][img]https://i.postimg.cc/mr5Cxn5q/mainbanner.png[/img]﻿﻿[/size][/b][/center]
[b][size=6]Description[/size][/b]
[color=#999999][size=5]Welcome to the Stardew Valley Flower Show, presented by the Ferngill Botanical Society! Held over two days in the summer, the Stardew Valley Flower Show is a celebration of all things flowers and focuses on Evelyn for the central events. Cheer her on as she competes for the Grand Prize Showcase![/size][/color]


[b][size=6]Main features[/size][/b]
[size=5][color=#999999]-- Two-day passive festival held in the summer at the same location as the Flower Dance[/color]
[color=#999999]-- 2 new events[/color]
[color=#999999]-- Special festival dialogue for vanilla NPCs[/color]
[color=#999999]-- 14 new crop varieties [/color]
[color=#999999]-- 2 new tree varieties[/color]
[color=#999999]-- 30 new furniture & decor items[/color][/size]

[color=#999999][size=5]...and more to come!            [img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGP1RTPj/garden.png[/img][/size][/color]

[b][size=6]Requirements[/size][/b]
[color=#999999][size=5]In addition to SMAPI and Content Patcher, the following mods are [b][u]required:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#999999][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff[/url] [/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9599]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Indoor[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#999999][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/url][/size][/color][/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#ffffff][size=6]Installation Instructions[/size][/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][color=#999999]Download the mod and all of the dependency mods listed above[/color][/size]
            ﻿[/*]
[*][size=4][color=#999999]Place inside your /Mods folder[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[color=#ffffff][size=6][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=5]Should be compatible with ALL recolor mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=5]COMPATIBLE WITH [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095][size=5]Aimon's Gem Sea Shores[/size][/url][size=5]﻿ - thank you to Aimon for making the compat patches![/size][/*]
[*][size=5]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]. [/size][/*]
[*][size=5]COMPATIBLE WITH [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290][size=5]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/size][/url][size=5], [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20598][size=5]Lumisteria Serene Meadow[/size][/url][size=5], [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600][size=5]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/size][/url][size=5], and thanks to Dolphin, [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358][size=5]They Deserve it Too - Portraits for Extras[/size][/url][size=5]![/size][/*]
[*][size=5]NEW: NOW FULLY COMPATIBLE WITH [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059][size=5]Diverse Stardew Valley[/size][/url][size=5]! Huge thanks to AirynS for coding the changes and for the art![/size][/*]
[/list][size=5]If you are a mod author and would [/size][size=4]like[/size][size=5] to discuss crossover or [/size][size=5]compatibility, please feel free to reach out here or on Discord. (I'm more likely to respond to Discord messages than mail here.)[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility patches in progress for: East Scarp + Add-Ons, Sunberry Village + Add-Ons, and Wildflour's Atelier Goods. Stay tuned![/size]


[size=5][b][u][i]None of this mod's assets may be used to train generative AI, nor can they be used in any AI-Generated content. [/i][/u][/b][/size]
